payload.title: DIP-L03: Supervise the recorder and recover safely after failure
payload.description:
Implementation gap. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

Login/profile startup exists, but the recorder has no complete OS-supervised crash recovery. Stale-heartbeat detection can still ask the user to stop/start it. Native Git trace files queue while it is stopped; filesystem and exact tool events cannot be assumed to have been observed during downtime.

Evidence and starting points: src/automation.js, docs/operations.md, docs/git-discovery.md.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
acceptance: Use user-level supervision or bounded recovery on supported platforms; validate crash, stale heartbeat, restart races and single-instance ownership.
Preserve the outbox and fencing rules across recovery; never revive expired/replaced leases or claim to reconstruct unobserved tool invocations.
Respect deliberate stop/uninstall and preserve existing startup settings, rollback and removal behavior.
Expose current health versus historical errors and any observation gap with reproducible failure/recovery tests.
